title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 150  An Act Further Amending Presidential Decree Numbered Two Hundred Sixty as Amended, By Including Six-Hundred-Year Old Karim Ul-Makhdum Mosque of Simunul, Tawi-Tawi, Among the National Landmarks and Monuments Declared as National Shrines.

text.en:
Section One of Presidential Decree Numbered Two Hundred sixty is hereby amended as follows:
"Sec. 1. The Sta. Ana Site Museum in Manila, the Roman Catholic Churches of Paoay and Bacarra in Ilocos
Norte, the San Agustin Church and Liturgical objects therein in Intramuros, Manila, Fort Pilar in Zamboanga
City, the Karim ul-Makhdum Mosque in Simunul, Tawi-Tawi, the Petroglyphs of the Rockshelter in Angono,
Rizal, the Petroglyphs of Alab, Bontoc, the Stone Agricultural Calendars of Dapay Guiday in Besao, Bontoc,
the Mummy Caves of Kabayan, Benguet and of Sagada and Alab, Bontoc, the Ifugao Rice Terraces of Banaue
are hereby declared as National Cultural Treasures along lines of Section 3 and 7 of R.A. No. 4846 defining
cultural properties and treasures, and their preservation, restoration and/or reconstruction shall be under the
supervision and control of the National Museum in collaboration with the Department of Tourism."
